not_shipped.why: Held locally, not redistributed. Download the Benchmarks from cisecurity.org into sources/cis/ under the filenames recorded here to rebuild anything that reads them.

not_copied.what: The SCuBA secure configuration baselines themselves
not_copied.why: The baselines are published by CISA and no copy of them is held here. What was read for this analysis was the baseline content as converted, and those conversions are published separately.

not_copied.what: The Security Hub controls, as published
not_copied.why: This publisher ships its guidance as OSCAL already, so there is no separate source document to hold. The published content is linked rather than copied, so there is one copy to keep current.
